summary: STRATS Trust for Goldman Sachs Capital I Securities, Series 2005-1 filed a routine Form 8-K reporting an ordinary scheduled distribution to certificate holders on September 15, 2026. The Trust holds junior subordinated debentures issued by Goldman Sachs Capital I as its sole assets. The filing includes Trustee's Distribution Statement as Exhibit 99.1 and explicitly states no other reportable transactions or matters occurred. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, strategic review, or management change is involved. This is a standard structured-finance pass-through distribution notice with no special-situation or risk-arb implications.
